description: Baseline strict-2D GW prescription: 2D Ewald Coulomb with analytic Gamma head/wing.

in_plane_kgrid.per_system_override_rule: Use a converged in-plane mesh; strict-2D needs a denser in-plane sampling than 3D because the vacuum truncates screening.
in_plane_kgrid.rationale: The in-plane mesh controls the 2D screening convergence; too coarse a mesh biases the q->0 head.

vacuum.per_system_override_rule: Converge the vacuum thickness so the 2D Ewald slab does not interact with its image.
vacuum.rationale: Insufficient vacuum makes the 2D Ewald Coulomb non-convergent and can render the auxiliary Coulomb indefinite.

ewald_precision.per_system_override_rule: Tighten the Ewald precision until the full Coulomb is Hermitian and positive-semidefinite.
ewald_precision.rationale: A loose Ewald precision leaves a non-Hermitian or indefinite auxiliary Coulomb that corrupts EXX and GW.

nfreq.per_system_override_rule: Use a moderately dense imaginary-frequency grid for the 2D screening.
nfreq.rationale: 2D screening converges more slowly in frequency than 3D.

nbands.per_system_override_rule: Set nbands equal to the physical basis dimension (nbasis); never truncate the state space.
nbands.rationale: An incomplete state space corrupts EXX/GW; nbands is system-dependent and never pinned.
